info.name: SPC Book Store
info.description:
Postman collection for the SPC Book Store API (ITPE101 final project) - a campus bookstore with verified-student discounts, campus pickup slots and a grounded AI assistant.

HOW TO RUN
1. Import this collection and the example environment (postman/environment.example.json), then select the environment.
2. Start the backend (cd backend && npm run seed && npm start) and make sure baseUrl points at it (default http://localhost:5000).
3. Run the "Setup & Auth" folder first: it logs in the seeded demo accounts and fills the collection variables (tokens and ids) used by every other request.
4. Run the whole collection (or folders in order). Every request carries assertions, including the negative cases required by T-13.

NOTES
- Checkout / Payments requests need PayMongo TEST keys in backend/.env. Without them the API answers 502 GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE and rolls the order back - the tests accept that as the designed safe behavior; everything else runs.
- The AI request works with or without a GEMINI_API_KEY: without a key it demonstrates the documented keyword fallback.
- Demo credentials (TEST ONLY, created by npm run seed): admin@spc.edu / Admin#1234, juan@spc.edu / Juan#1234 (verified student), maria@spc.edu / Maria#1234.
- No secrets are stored in this collection: tokens are runtime collection variables set by the Login requests.
- The API contract is openapi.yaml (served live at /api-docs).

description.content: RUN THIS FOLDER FIRST. It logs in the seeded demo accounts and fills collection variables (tokens and ids) used by every other request. Credentials are TEST-ONLY demo accounts created by `npm run seed`.

request.description: API is up. No auth required.

exec: pm.test('API answers with the standard envelope', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('ok'));

request.description: Demo admin account from the seed. The test script stores the JWT in the collection variable adminToken.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 and a token was issued', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.token).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Juan is a VERIFIED student in the seed: his checkout automatically receives the server-side student discount (Level 3 feature 1).

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 and a token was issued', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.token).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Positive registration including a student record: queued as pending for the admin verification queue.

exec: pm.test('Bootstrap rule: later accounts are customers, not admins', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.user.role).to.eql('customer'));
pm.test('Student verification queued as pending (L3 feature 1)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.user.student.status).to.eql('pending'));

request.description: Seed check: at least 5 categories (L1-13).
Seed check: at least 20 products (L1-13). Picks a purchasable product for the cart/checkout tests and the lowest-stock product for the out-of-stock negative test.

exec: pm.test('Every price is an integer amount of centavos', () => j.data.forEach(p => pm.expect(Number.isInteger(p.priceCents)).to.be.true));
pm.test('A purchasable product exists for the cart tests', () => pm.expect(buyable.length).to.be.at.least(1));

if (buyable.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', buyable[0]._id); pm.collectionVariables.set('productPriceCents', String(buyable[0].priceCents)); pm.collectionVariables.set('lowStockProductId', buyable.slice().sort((a, b) => a.stock - b.stock)[0]._id); }

request.description: Level 3 feature 2: public slot list with remaining capacity.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 with at least one slot', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.at.least(1); });
pm.test('Remaining capacity never exceeds capacity', () => j.data.forEach(s => pm.expect(s.remaining).to.be.at.most(s.capacity)));

description.content: Open endpoints, no token needed (L1-03 / L1-04).

request.description: Searches title, author, description and course code.
Campus-bookstore filter: every result belongs to the requested course (L3 supporting feature).

exec: pm.test('All results match the course filter', () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.courseCode).to.eql('IT101')));

request.description: Whitelisted sort keys only (T-06).

exec: pm.test('Results are sorted ascending by price', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data.length > 1) { pm.expect(j.data[0].priceCents).to.be.at.most(j.data[j.data.length - 1].priceCents); } });

request.description: Price and stock must match the database record captured during Setup.

exec: pm.test('Price matches the catalog record (server truth)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.priceCents).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('productPriceCents'))));

request.description: meta.total, meta.page and meta.limit are always returned (T-06).

exec: pm.test('meta reflects the requested page and limit', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.meta.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.meta.limit).to.eql(5); });

description.content: Server-owned cart; every total is computed by the API, never by the client (L1-05). All requests use the customer token.

request.description: Returns items with line totals and subtotalCents computed on the server.

exec: pm.test('Totals are server-computed integers', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Number.isInteger(j.data.subtotalCents)).to.be.true; pm.expect(Number.isInteger(j.data.itemCount)).to.be.true; });

request.description: Adds one unit of the product picked during Setup. Adding beyond available stock is rejected with 409 (see Negative folder).

exec: pm.test('Cart now contains the product', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.itemCount).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(j.data.items.some(i => String(i.productId) === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId'))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Cart line carries the database price, not a client price', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); const line = j.data.items.find(i => String(i.productId) === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')); pm.expect(line.priceCents).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('productPriceCents'))); });

pm.test('Line total = price x qty (server math)', () => { const line = pm.response.json().data.items.find(i => String(i.productId) === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId')); if (line) { pm.expect(line.lineTotalCents).to.eql(line.priceCents * line.qty); } });
pm.test('Item is gone from the cart', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.items.some(i => String(i.productId) === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId'))).to.eql(false));

description.content:
Creates an order (pending_payment), reserves stock atomically, then returns a hosted PayMongo TEST-mode checkout URL.

IMPORTANT: set PAYMONGO_SECRET_KEY in backend/.env before running these two requests.
Without keys the API responds 502 GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE and rolls the order back - that is the designed, safe behavior and the tests accept it.

Totals are recomputed on the server: the tampered priceCents in the first request body is ignored (L2-02).
The Idempotency-Key header makes repeated clicks safe (L2-08); the same key is replayed in the Negative folder.

request.description: BOOKS50 requires a 300 peso minimum spend; checkoutQty is computed so the subtotal always qualifies. Juan is a verified student, so the automatic student discount also applies.

exec: pm.test('201 order created, or 502 when PayMongo test keys are not configured (order rolled back)', () => pm.expect([201, 502]).to.include(pm.response.code));

pm.test('Tampered client price ignored - database price wins (L2-02)', () => { pm.expect(Number(j.data.order.items[0].priceCents)).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('productPriceCents'))); pm.expect(j.data.order.items[0].title).to.not.eql('TAMPERED-PRICE'); });

pm.test('Total = subtotal - student discount - coupon + shipping', () => { const o = j.data.order; pm.expect(o.totalCents).to.eql(o.subtotalCents - o.studentDiscountCents - o.discountCents + o.shippingFeeCents); });
pm.test('Controlled rollback envelope (no partial state)', () => { pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql('GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE'); });

item.name: Checkout - campus pickup with slot (no shipping fee)

request.description: Level 3 feature 2: claims a campus pickup slot; pickup orders never pay the shipping fee.

exec: pm.test('201 created, 409 when the slot is full, or 502 without gateway keys', () => pm.expect([201, 409, 502]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('Campus pickup has no shipping fee (L3 feature 2)', () => pm.expect(j.data.order.shippingFeeCents).to.eql(0));
pm.test('Slot capacity / stock enforced atomically', () => pm.expect(['PICKUP_SLOT_FULL', 'OUT_OF_STOCK']).to.include(j.error.code));

description.content:
Customer order endpoints. Detail / cancel / retry depend on the order created in the Checkout folder;
if the gateway keys were missing, orderId is unset and those requests respond 404 (the tests accept it).

request.description: Only the signed-in customers orders are returned (L1-07).

exec: pm.test('Orders carry lifecycle statuses', () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(o => pm.expect(['pending_payment', 'paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled', 'expired']).to.include(o.status)));

request.description: Every transition is recorded with actor and timestamp (L2-04).

exec: pm.test('200 detail, or 404 when no order exists (gateway keys missing)', () => pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('Order number matches the created order', () => pm.expect(j.data.order.orderNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderNumber')));

request.description: Cancelling releases reserved stock. A PAID order cannot be cancelled: the state machine answers 409 (L1-07 / L2-04).

exec: pm.test('200 cancelled, 409 state-machine protection, or 404 without an order', () => pm.expect([200, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Unhappy-path recovery: issues a fresh payment session for an unpaid order (L2-07).

exec: pm.test('200 new session, 409 after a terminal state, 404 without an order, 502 without keys', () => pm.expect([200, 404, 409, 502]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('A NEW hosted checkout URL is issued', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.checkoutUrl).to.include('http'));

description.content: Retrieve-on-return reconciliation (L2-06). The signed webhook endpoint itself is exercised in the Negative folder.

request.description: Asks the gateway for the real status, amount and currency and can mark the order paid even when the webhook was missed.

exec: pm.test('200 verified status, or 404/409 without an order or session', () => pm.expect([200, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

description.content:
Level 4: grounded AI product discovery. Candidates come from the database, every returned product id is validated,
and names/prices/stock are re-read from MongoDB. Without a Gemini key the endpoint answers with the documented
keyword fallback (source: 'fallback') instead of failing.

item.name: Ask for a networking book (grounded answer)

request.description: Works with or without a GEMINI_API_KEY: with a key it returns an AI-ranked answer, without it the keyword fallback.

exec: pm.test('Source is ai or the documented keyword fallback (L4-06)', () => pm.expect(['ai', 'fallback']).to.include(pm.response.json().data.source));

pm.test('Products are grounded database records (integer centavos, L4-05)', () => pm.response.json().data.products.forEach(p => { pm.expect(Number.isInteger(p.priceCents)).to.be.true; pm.expect(p.stock).to.be.at.least(0); }));
if (pm.response.json().data.source === 'fallback') { console.log('AI provider unavailable or not configured - fallbackReason: ' + pm.response.json().data.fallbackReason); }

description.content:
Every endpoint here requires the admin role. A customer token receives 403 (see Negative folder).
Create product / coupon / slot use dynamic values so the collection can be re-run safely.

request.description: Figures reconcile directly with the database (L1-12).

exec: pm.test('Dashboard figures present', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.property('totalPaidOrders'); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('grossSalesCents'); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('pendingOrders'); pm.expect(d.lowStock).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: Price is sent in PESOS and converted to integer centavos by the server.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Postman Test Book {{$timestamp}}",
  "author": "QA Bot",
  "description": "Created by the Postman collection run",
  "price": 199,
  "categoryId": "{{categoryId}}",
  "stock": 3,
  "courseCode": "IT999"
}

request.description: Every stock change records previous value, new value, delta, reason and actor (L1-10). Stock can never go below zero.

exec: pm.test('Audit shows 3 -> 2 with delta -1', () => { const m = pm.response.json().data.movement; pm.expect(m.previousStock).to.eql(3); pm.expect(m.newStock).to.eql(2); pm.expect(m.delta).to.eql(-1); });

pm.test('At least one audit entry with previous/new/reason', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.at.least(1); const m = j.data[0]; pm.expect(m).to.have.property('previousStock'); pm.expect(m).to.have.property('newStock'); pm.expect(m).to.have.property('reason'); });

request.description: Soft delete: the product is hidden but order history keeps its snapshot (L1-09).

exec: pm.test('Seeded coupons present, including EXPIRED5 used by the negative tests', () => { const codes = pm.response.json().data.map(c => c.code); pm.expect(codes).to.include('WELCOME10'); pm.expect(codes).to.include('EXPIRED5'); });

request.description: 5 percent off with a 100 peso minimum spend, valid for one week.
Level 3 feature 2: staff control pickup capacity. The window is unique per date, so re-running stays safe.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 201 created with capacity 2 and 0 booked', () => { const s = pm.response.json().data; pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(s.capacity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(s.booked).to.eql(0); });

request.description: Level 3 feature 1: pending verifications awaiting an admin decision.

exec: pm.test('Queue entries have a verification status', () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(s => pm.expect(['pending', 'verified', 'rejected']).to.include(s.student.status)));

request.description: Approving activates the automatic student discount for that customer at checkout (L3 feature 1).

description.content:
Required negative coverage (T-13): unauthenticated 401, forbidden 403, not-found 404, invalid input 422,
out-of-stock 409, invalid coupon 422, invalid webhook signature 401, duplicate idempotency (no duplicate order).
Run after Setup & Auth (needs tokens and ids).

request.description: No Authorization header at all.

exec: pm.test('UNAUTHENTICATED error code with requestId', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('requestId'); });

request.description: Role checks happen on the server, not only in the UI (L1-02 / S-03).
A well-formed but nonexistent id.

item.name: Invalid registration input -> 422 with field details

request.description: Bad name, email and password: field-level details come back (T-03 / S-04).

exec: pm.test('VALIDATION_ERROR with at least one field detail', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql('VALIDATION_ERROR'); pm.expect(Object.keys(j.error.details).length).to.be.at.least(1); });

request.description: Requests 99 units of the lowest-stock product found during Setup.

exec: pm.test('OUT_OF_STOCK with the available quantity in the message', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql('OUT_OF_STOCK'); pm.expect(j.error.message).to.include('left in stock'); });

request.description: EXPIRED5 is a seeded expired coupon: validation fails before any order is created and the total is unchanged.

item.name: Duplicate idempotency: same key -> same order, no duplicate

request.description: Replays the EXACT key and body of the first checkout request. The API must return the same order, not create a second one (L2-08).

exec: pm.test('200 replay, or 502 when the original checkout also failed (no keys)', () => pm.expect([200, 502]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('Replayed flag set - no duplicate order created', () => pm.expect(j.meta.replayed).to.eql(true));
pm.test('Same order id as the first checkout', () => pm.expect(j.data.order._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')));

request.description: Forged signature over the raw body is rejected before anything else happens (S-07 / L2-05).
pending_payment -> delivered is not an allowed transition; the state machine answers 409 (L2-04).

exec: pm.test('409 illegal transition, or 404 when no order exists', () => pm.expect([409, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Input bound enforced before the provider is called (L4-08).
